title: Derived pullback commutes with derived tensor product
statement: Let $g:T\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with derived pullback $Lg^*:D(\mathcal O_S)\to D(\mathcal O_T)$ [def-pc-derived-pullback] on the derived categories of [def-pc-derived-category]. For a scheme $Z$ and $K,L\in D(\mathcal O_Z)$ write $K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_Z}L$ for the derived tensor product, represented by $\operatorname{Tot}(\mathcal P^\bullet\otimes_{\mathcal O_Z}\mathcal L^\bullet)$ [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] for a K-flat complex $\mathcal P^\bullet$ with a quasi-isomorphism $\mathcal P^\bullet\to K$ [def-pc-kflat-complex, lem-pc-kflat-resolution] and a complex $\mathcal L^\bullet$ representing $L$. Then for $K,L\in D(\mathcal O_S)$ there is a canonical isomorphism $$Lg^*(K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_S}L)\cong Lg^*K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_T}Lg^*L$$ in $D(\mathcal O_T)$, natural in $K$ and $L$.

proof.text: Choose K-flat flat-term complexes $\mathcal P^\bullet\to K$ and $\mathcal L^\bullet\to L$ with quasi-isomorphisms by [lem-pc-kflat-resolution]. Their termwise pullbacks are K-flat by [lem-pc-kflat-pullback-preservation] and represent $Lg^*K$ and $Lg^*L$ by [def-pc-derived-pullback]. Then [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] identifies $K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_S}L$ with $\operatorname{Tot}(\mathcal P^\bullet\otimes_{\mathcal O_S}\mathcal L^\bullet)$, and [lem-pc-kflat-tensor-product] makes this total complex K-flat, so it is a valid representative for applying $Lg^*$.

For every bidegree $(p,q)$, [lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-tensor] gives the isomorphism $g^*(\mathcal P^p\otimes_{\mathcal O_S}\mathcal L^q)\cong g^*\mathcal P^p\otimes_{\mathcal O_T}g^*\mathcal L^q$ of $\mathcal O_T$-modules, natural in both factors and sending $g^*(s\otimes t)$ to $g^*s\otimes g^*t$. By this naturality these maps commute with the differentials $d\otimes1$ and $(-1)^p1\otimes d$, and pullback commutes with the direct sums in totalization, so they induce an isomorphism of total complexes. The target total complex computes $Lg^*K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_T}Lg^*L$ because $g^*\mathcal P^\bullet$ is K-flat and represents $Lg^*K$, while $g^*\mathcal L^\bullet$ represents $Lg^*L$ by [def-pc-derived-pullback] and [lem-pc-kflat-pullback-preservation]. The construction is canonical and natural in $K$ and $L$ because resolution comparison and tensor associativity maps are natural.
